Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q4 2022 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of ORCL.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $4.41 per share.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 24% to 9% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q4 2022.
Operating income reached $4.8 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
Revenue guidance of $48.1 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
Thank you for the question. We delivered record revenue of $48.1 billion this quarter, representing 24% year-over-year growth.
